Content Creator Prompt Kit

🎥 YouTube Scripts & Ideas

1

YouTube Video Script Writer (Complete)

You are a YouTube scriptwriter who specializes in high-retention videos for Indian audiences. Write a complete script for: Channel Niche: [e.g., personal finance / tech reviews / fitness / cooking / motivation] Video Topic: [e.g., "5 money mistakes every 20-something Indian makes"] Target Viewer: [e.g., college students aged 18-24 in India] Video Length: [e.g., 8-10 minutes] Tone: [e.g., casual & funny / serious & informative / motivational] Language: [English / Hindi / Hinglish mix] Write the complete script with these sections: HOOK (0-30 sec): Open with a shocking stat, bold claim, or relatable question that makes them stay. This is the MOST important part — 70% of viewers leave in the first 30 seconds. INTRO (30-60 sec): Brief self-intro + "By the end of this video, you'll know..." promise. Include a subscribe CTA here. BODY (3-5 main points): For each point: - Transition line (so the video flows, not jumps) - The point explained simply with an example - An Indian-context analogy or reference - A brief personal story or case study - Pattern interrupt every 2 minutes (question to viewer, visual change cue, "but here's the twist...") CLIMAX: The most valuable insight — save the best for last CTA (final 30 sec): Subscribe + comment question + next video teaser Also provide: - 5 title options (with curiosity gaps and numbers) - Thumbnail text suggestions (3-5 words max) - Description with timestamps and keywords - 15 tags for YouTube SEO
💡 Pro Tip: The hook decides your video's fate. Test your hook by reading it aloud — if YOU wouldn't keep watching, rewrite it. Use the "Open Loop" technique: hint at something coming later ("I'll share the exact method in point #4").
2

30 YouTube Video Ideas Generator

Generate 30 YouTube video ideas for my channel: Channel Niche: [your niche] Current Subscriber Count: [approximate] Target Audience: [who watches your videos] Your Best-Performing Videos: [list 2-3 titles that did well] Competitors to Study: [list 2-3 channels in your niche] For each of the 30 ideas, provide: - Video title (optimized for CTR with curiosity gaps) - Content angle (what makes YOUR take unique) - Estimated search demand (high/medium/low) - Video type: Tutorial / Listicle / Story / Reaction / Comparison / Vlog - Difficulty to produce: Easy / Medium / Hard Organize into categories: - 10 "Search-driven" ideas (topics people Google/YouTube search for) - 10 "Browse-driven" ideas (viral/trending topics that get suggested) - 5 "Authority builders" (deep dives that establish expertise) - 5 "Community builders" (Q&A, challenges, collabs) Focus on topics relevant to Indian audiences and current trends.
💡 Pro Tip: Start with the "Search-driven" ideas first if you're under 10K subs. These bring consistent new viewers through YouTube search. Once you have 50K+ subs, switch to "Browse-driven" for viral growth.
3

YouTube Shorts Script (Under 60 Seconds)

Write a YouTube Shorts script (under 60 seconds) for: Topic: [topic or tip you want to share] Niche: [your channel niche] Format: [talking head / text overlay / screen recording / skit] Script structure (total under 150 words): HOOK (0-3 sec): One explosive sentence. This is everything. SETUP (3-10 sec): Quick context — why this matters CONTENT (10-45 sec): The actual tip/story/info — fast-paced, no filler PUNCHLINE (45-55 sec): Surprising twist or key takeaway CTA (55-60 sec): "Follow for more" or "Comment [keyword]" Also provide: - 3 hook alternatives (test which one works) - Text overlay text for key moments - Hashtags (5 relevant ones) - Caption text Rules: - ZERO filler words — every second counts - Use pattern interrupts (visual zoom, text pop, sound effect cue) - End before the viewer expects it — short = rewatched = algorithmic boost
💡 Pro Tip: The #1 Shorts metric is "replays." Make your Short so fast and value-packed that people need to watch twice. Aim for under 45 seconds — shorter Shorts get replayed more.
4

YouTube Video Description & SEO Optimizer

Optimize this YouTube video for search and discovery: Video Title: [your title] Video Topic: [what the video covers] Target Keywords: [3-5 keywords you want to rank for] Video Length: [duration] Timestamps: [list the main sections with approximate times] Generate: 1. OPTIMIZED DESCRIPTION (first 2 lines most important — they show in search): - Line 1-2: Keyword-rich summary that compels clicking - Lines 3-8: Detailed description with natural keyword placement - Timestamps section - Links section (social media, mentioned resources) - Hashtags (3 relevant ones) 2. 20 TAGS: Mix of broad + specific + long-tail keywords 3. 3 ALTERNATIVE TITLES: For A/B testing 4. END SCREEN SUGGESTIONS: 2 video ideas to suggest at the end 5. PINNED COMMENT: A question or bonus tip to boost engagement
💡 Pro Tip: YouTube's algorithm reads your first 2 description lines heavily. Include your primary keyword in the first sentence. Also, pinned comments with questions boost engagement rate by 15-20%.

📸 Instagram Reels, Carousels & Captions

5

Instagram Reel Hook & Script Generator

Write an Instagram Reel script that will go viral with Indian audiences: Topic: [what you want to teach/show/entertain with] Niche: [your content niche] Target Audience: [who should watch this] Reel Length: [15 sec / 30 sec / 60 sec / 90 sec] Style: [talking head / transition / trending audio lip-sync / tutorial / skit] Write: 1. 5 HOOK OPTIONS (first 1-3 seconds — THE most important part): - Pattern interrupt hook ("STOP scrolling if you...") - Curiosity hook ("Nobody talks about this...") - Contrarian hook ("Everything you know about X is wrong") - Results hook ("This one change got me X results") - Relatable hook ("POV: You're a [target] trying to...") 2. FULL SCRIPT with: - Shot-by-shot breakdown - Text overlay suggestions (what text to add on screen) - Transition cues (if applicable) - Music/audio mood recommendation 3. CAPTION (under 150 words): - Strong opening line (visible before "...more") - Value extension (add context the Reel didn't cover) - CTA (save, share, follow, comment) 4. 20 HASHTAGS: 7 broad (1M+) + 7 niche (10K-100K) + 6 India-specific 5. BEST POSTING TIME for this content type in India
💡 Pro Tip: Save all 5 hooks and use them for 5 different Reels on the same topic — repurpose ONE idea into 5 different hooks. The hook that gets the highest "Accounts Reached" wins. Double down on that hook style.
6

Instagram Carousel Builder (10 Slides)

Create a 10-slide Instagram carousel that gets saved and shared: Topic: [educational topic you want to cover] Target Audience: [who needs this information] Goal: [educate / inspire / sell / grow followers] Write text content for each slide: SLIDE 1 — THE HOOK: Bold statement, question, or shocking fact. This is the "cover" — it must make them swipe. Use large text, minimal words (under 10 words). SLIDE 2 — THE PROBLEM: Why this topic matters. Create emotional connection. SLIDE 3-8 — THE CONTENT: One key point per slide. Rules for each: - Clear heading (under 8 words) - Supporting detail (2-3 short lines) - Keep text minimal — this is visual, not a blog post SLIDE 9 — SUMMARY/TAKEAWAY: Recap all points in one quick visual SLIDE 10 — CTA SLIDE: "Save this for later 🔖" + "Share with someone who needs this" + "Follow @[handle] for more" Also provide: - Caption (under 200 words) with expanded context - 20 hashtags - Design style suggestion (colors, fonts, layout reference)
💡 Pro Tip: Carousels have the highest save rate of any Instagram format. Every save = a signal to the algorithm that your content has long-term value. Saves > Likes for reach. Always end with "Save this 🔖".
7

30-Day Instagram Content Calendar

Create a complete 30-day Instagram content calendar for: Niche: [your content niche] Target Audience: [who follows you / should follow you] Goals: [grow followers / build authority / drive sales / build community] Content Strengths: [what you're good at — talking head / design / photography / humor] Posting Frequency: [daily / 5x week / 3x week] For each of the 30 days, provide: - Content Type: Reel / Carousel / Single Image / Story Series - Topic + Hook Line (first text people see) - Brief Outline (3-4 bullet points of what to cover) - Content Pillar: Educate (40%) / Entertain (20%) / Engage (20%) / Sell (20%) - Best Posting Time Content mix requirements: - At least 15 Reels (60% — algorithm favors video) - At least 6 Carousels (20% — high save rate) - At least 4 Stories-focused days (engagement builders) - 2 collaboration/duet ideas - 2 trending audio adaptations - 2 "behind the scenes" posts - 1 meme/relatable humor post - 2 posts tied to Indian cultural moments / festivals / trending topics Also provide: - 5 recurring "series" name ideas (e.g., "Monday Myths," "Friday Wins") - A hashtag strategy (3 hashtag sets to rotate)
💡 Pro Tip: Batch-create content. Use this calendar to shoot all Reels in 1-2 days, design all carousels in 1 day, then schedule using Meta Business Suite. Consistency > quality for the first 90 days of growth.
8

Viral Caption Generator (5 Variations)

Write 5 different Instagram caption styles for this post: Post Content: [describe what the image/video shows] Topic: [what you're talking about] Goal: [engagement / follows / saves / shares / link clicks] Write 5 variations, each with a different approach: 1. STORYTELLING: Open with "I remember when..." or "2 years ago, I..." — personal story that leads to a lesson 2. LISTICLE: "5 things I wish I knew about..." — numbered tips with emojis 3. CONTROVERSIAL: Start with a bold opinion that makes people stop — "Unpopular opinion: [hot take]" 4. QUESTION-LED: Open with a question, answer it in the caption, end with another question 5. ONE-LINER: Ultra-short, punchy, screenshot-worthy — under 15 words total For each caption: - Write the full caption text (under 150 words) - Add a CTA at the end - Include a comment-driving question - Keep first line powerful (visible before "...more")
💡 Pro Tip: The first line (before "...more") has to be SO compelling that they MUST tap to read more. Test each style for a week and track which gets the most comments. Comments are the #1 signal Instagram uses for reach.
9

Instagram Story Series Script (5-7 Slides)

Create a tap-through Instagram Story series to boost engagement: Topic: [what you want to share — tip, story, poll, Q&A, behind-the-scenes] Goal: [drive DMs / grow close friends list / promote product / educate] Write 5-7 Story slides: SLIDE 1: Hook question or bold statement (use large text sticker) — make them want to tap next SLIDE 2: Context or setup — why this matters SLIDE 3: The core content (keep text under 30 words per slide) SLIDE 4: Interactive element (POLL / QUIZ / QUESTION BOX / SLIDER) — specify the exact question SLIDE 5: Continue the content or share a personal take SLIDE 6: CTA slide (DM me "keyword" / vote in poll / reply to question) SLIDE 7 (optional): Promo or redirect ("swipe up" or "check link in bio") For each slide specify: - Text content - Background suggestion (selfie / screenshot / plain color / photo) - Sticker to use (poll, quiz, question, countdown, link) - Music mood (if applicable)
💡 Pro Tip: Stories with interactive stickers (polls, quizzes, sliders) get 3x more engagement than passive text stories. The "Question" sticker is the best DM-generator — "Reply to this story with your biggest challenge in [niche]."

💼 LinkedIn Content

10

LinkedIn Thought-Leadership Post Writer

Write a high-engagement LinkedIn post for an Indian professional: Your Role/Title: [e.g., Marketing Manager / Startup Founder / Freelance Designer] Topic: [what you want to talk about] Your Personal Experience with This Topic: [a brief story or observation] Key Takeaway for Readers: [what should they learn/think after reading] Write the post using this structure: LINE 1: A bold, scroll-stopping opening line (this shows before "...see more" — it MUST compel a click) Formats that work: "I got rejected from [company]. Best thing that ever happened." OR "Hot take: [common belief] is completely wrong. Here's why." OR "In 2024, I was [bad situation]. Today, [good situation]. Here's what changed:" LINES 2-12: The story/insight — keep paragraphs to 1-2 sentences each - Use line breaks between every 1-2 sentences (LinkedIn = easy scanning) - Include specific numbers and details (not vague) - Add a turning point or "aha moment" FINAL LINES: - Key takeaway in 1-2 sentences - Engagement question ("What's your experience with this? Drop a comment.") HASHTAGS: 5-8 relevant hashtags Length: 150-250 words. Tone: authentic, not preachy. Personal > generic.
💡 Pro Tip: LinkedIn's algorithm in India favors personal stories over corporate announcements. Posts starting with "I" outperform posts starting with "We" or brand names by 3x. Share failures and lessons, not just wins.
11

LinkedIn Carousel Document Creator

Create a LinkedIn carousel (PDF document post) with 10 slides: Topic: [educational/insightful topic] Target Audience: [who should engage with this — marketers / founders / developers] Your Expertise Angle: [why you're qualified to share this] Write text for each slide: SLIDE 1: Title slide — bold headline + your name/handle + "swipe →" SLIDE 2: The problem or question this carousel answers SLIDE 3-8: One insight/tip per slide (heading + 2-3 supporting lines) SLIDE 9: Summary of all points SLIDE 10: CTA — "Found this useful? ♻️ Repost to help your network. Follow [name] for more." Also write: - A LinkedIn post caption (100-150 words) to accompany the carousel - Design direction (color scheme, font style suggestion) Rules for each slide: - Max 40 words per slide - Use numbered points or bullet format - Include an icon/emoji suggestion for each slide - Make it scannable in 3 seconds
💡 Pro Tip: LinkedIn carousels have the highest organic reach of any content type in 2026. The "swipe →" on slide 1 is critical — without it, people don't realize they can swipe. Design in Canva using a 1:1 or 4:5 ratio.
12

Weekly LinkedIn Content Plan (5 Posts)

Create a weekly LinkedIn posting schedule for me: My Profile: [your role, industry, what you want to be known for] Goals: [grow network / attract clients / job opportunities / thought leadership] Posting Frequency: 5 posts per week (Mon-Fri) Generate a week's worth of posts with this content mix: MONDAY — Story Post: A personal/professional story with a lesson (vulnerability works) TUESDAY — Tactical Post: A specific how-to, framework, or tip list WEDNESDAY — Carousel: A visual educational post (provide slide-by-slide text) THURSDAY — Contrarian Take: Challenge a common belief in your industry FRIDAY — Engagement Post: A question, poll, or "this or that" debate For each post provide: - The complete post text (ready to copy-paste) - Best posting time (IST) - Expected engagement type (comments / shares / saves / DMs) - 5-8 hashtags
💡 Pro Tip: Run this prompt every Sunday evening and schedule all 5 posts. After 4 weeks (20 posts), you'll have a clear picture of which content pillar your audience resonates with. Double down on the winner.

✍️ Blogs, Newsletters & Long-Form

13

Blog Post Outline & Draft Generator

Write a comprehensive blog post for my website/newsletter: Topic: [blog post topic] Target Keyword: [primary SEO keyword] Target Reader: [who will read this — beginners / professionals / specific demographic] Word Count Target: [e.g., 1,500-2,000 words] Tone: [conversational / professional / academic / fun] Generate: 1. 5 TITLE OPTIONS: Include the target keyword, use numbers or power words 2. META DESCRIPTION: Under 155 characters, compelling for Google search 3. OUTLINE: H2 and H3 headings with brief notes for each section 4. INTRODUCTION (200 words): Hook + problem + promise of what they'll learn 5. BODY SECTIONS: For each H2 section, write 200-300 words with: - Actionable advice (not fluff) - Indian examples/context where relevant - Data/statistics to back up points 6. CONCLUSION: Summary + clear CTA (subscribe / read next / implement) 7. INTERNAL LINK SUGGESTIONS: Where to link to related content Rules: - Write for humans first, SEO second - Use short paragraphs (2-3 sentences max) - Include the target keyword in: title, first paragraph, one H2, and naturally 3-4 times in body - Add a "Key Takeaway" box after each major section
💡 Pro Tip: After generating, paste the draft into Hemingway Editor (free) — it'll highlight sentences that are too complex. Aim for Grade 6-8 readability. Simple writing ranks better on Google and gets shared more.
14

Newsletter Issue Writer

Write a newsletter issue for my email subscribers: Newsletter Name: [name of your newsletter] Niche: [what your newsletter covers] This Week's Theme: [the main topic for this issue] Key Insight: [the #1 thing you want readers to remember] Any News/Links to Share: [relevant links, tools, resources] Write: 1. SUBJECT LINE: 5 options (mix of curiosity, number-driven, and emoji-enhanced) 2. PREVIEW TEXT: Under 80 characters (shows in email preview) 3. OPENING: Personal, conversational, like writing to a friend 4. MAIN CONTENT: The insight/lesson/story (300-500 words) 5. ACTIONABLE TAKEAWAY: "Here's what to do this week: [specific action]" 6. RESOURCE CORNER: 2-3 curated links with 1-line descriptions 7. SIGN-OFF: Personal, warm, signature style 8. PS LINE: A teaser for next week or a casual CTA Total length: Under 800 words. Scannable. Mobile-first formatting.
💡 Pro Tip: The PS line gets read by 79% of email openers — it's prime CTA real estate. Use it for your most important ask: "PS: I'm launching a course next month. Reply 'interested' to get early access pricing."

🐦 Twitter/X Threads & Posts

15

Viral Twitter/X Thread Writer

Write a Twitter/X thread that gets bookmarked and shared: Topic: [what the thread teaches] Number of Tweets: [8-15 tweets] Your Angle: [personal experience / research / industry insider knowledge] Write each tweet (under 280 characters each): TWEET 1 (THE HOOK): The most important tweet. Must be so compelling that people NEED to read the thread. Formats: "I spent [X time] studying [topic]. Here's what nobody tells you: 🧵" "[X] changed my [life/career/business]. Here are the [N] lessons: ↓" TWEETS 2-N (BODY): One clear point per tweet. Rules: - Start each with a number or emoji for scannability - Include specific examples, not vague claims - Add a "bookmark this" worthy tip every 3-4 tweets - Break up text — short lines, not walls FINAL TWEET (CTA): Recap + "If you found this useful: 1) Retweet tweet #1, 2) Follow @[handle] for more, 3) Reply with your favorite tip" Also provide: - 3 standalone tweet ideas derived from this thread (repurpose content) - Best time to post threads for Indian audience
💡 Pro Tip: Post Twitter threads between 8-9 AM IST or 9-10 PM IST for maximum Indian engagement. The first tweet should be so strong that people retweet it even without reading the thread.

💰 Monetization & Collaborations

16

Brand Collaboration Pitch Email

Write a professional pitch email to a brand for a paid collaboration: My Name/Channel: [your name and platform] My Niche: [content niche] My Audience Size: [followers/subscribers] My Audience Demographics: [age, gender, location, interests] Average Engagement Rate: [likes, comments, views per post] Brand I'm Pitching: [brand name] Why This Brand: [genuine reason — you use their product, audience match, etc.] Collaboration Idea: [what you're proposing — Reel, YouTube review, Stories, etc.] Write: 1. SUBJECT LINE: 3 options (avoid "collaboration opportunity" — too generic) 2. EMAIL BODY: - Opening: Genuine compliment about the brand (specific, not generic) - Why you're a fit: Your audience alignment with their target market - Your idea: Specific collaboration concept with deliverables - Social proof: Best performance metrics, past brand work - Next step: Low-friction CTA ("Can I send you a detailed proposal?") 3. MEDIA KIT DESCRIPTION: What to include in your attached media kit Keep it under 200 words. Confident, not desperate. You're offering value, not asking for favors.
💡 Pro Tip: The #1 mistake Indian creators make: pitching to a brand's general email. Instead, find the specific marketing manager on LinkedIn and DM them a 3-line version first. Then follow up with the full email pitch.
17

Digital Product Idea Generator for Creators

Help me create a digital product to monetize my audience: My Niche: [content niche] My Audience: [who follows me — demographics, skill level, problems they have] My Strengths: [what you're really good at teaching/doing] My Most-Asked DM Questions: [what do followers always ask you?] Generate: 1. 5 DIGITAL PRODUCT IDEAS (ranked by ease of creation): For each: - Product name - Format (PDF guide / Notion template / video course / template pack / prompt bundle) - What it solves - Price point suggestion (₹ for Indian market) - Time to create - Revenue potential estimate 2. RECOMMENDED FIRST PRODUCT: Which one to build first and why 3. LAUNCH STRATEGY: 7-day launch sequence (what to post each day) 4. PRICING PSYCHOLOGY: Why the suggested price works for Indian audience Focus on products that take under 2 weeks to create and can be sold at ₹299-₹999.
💡 Pro Tip: Your most-asked DM questions are literally your audience TELLING you what to sell. If 50 people ask "How do you edit your Reels?", that's your ₹499 editing template pack waiting to be built.
18

Creator Collaboration Proposal (DM Script)

Write a DM to another creator to propose a collaboration: My Profile: [your niche, followers, content style] Their Profile: [their niche, followers, what you admire about them] Collaboration Idea: [joint Reel / podcast appearance / Instagram Live / collab post / challenge] Mutual Benefit: [how both audiences benefit] Write: 1. SHORT DM (under 40 words): Initial reach-out — casual, genuine, specific 2. FOLLOW-UP DM (if they're interested — under 60 words): The actual proposal with details 3. FORMAL EMAIL (if they have a business email — under 150 words): Professional version Rules: - Compliment something SPECIFIC about their recent content - Lead with what THEY get (not what you want) - Suggest a specific format (not "let's collab sometime") - Keep the first DM incredibly short — long DMs from strangers get ignored
💡 Pro Tip: Before DMing, engage with their content for 2 weeks — like, comment thoughtfully, share their posts. When you finally DM, they'll already recognize your name. This 10x your response rate.

🔗 Advanced Workflow Chains

C1

Content Repurposing Machine (1 Idea → 10 Pieces)

Turn ONE content idea into 10 pieces across platforms. Run in order. STEP 1 — Core Content: "I want to create content about: [topic]. My niche is [niche] and my audience is [target audience]. Write a comprehensive 800-word blog post / newsletter covering this topic with personal insights and actionable tips." STEP 2 — YouTube Script: "Now turn this blog post into an 8-minute YouTube script with hooks, transitions, pattern interrupts, and a strong CTA. Add B-roll/visual cues." STEP 3 — Instagram Content: "From this same content, create: 1) A 30-second Reel script with 3 hook options, 2) A 10-slide carousel with text for each slide, 3) A single-image caption post. All optimized for Indian Instagram users." STEP 4 — LinkedIn + Twitter: "Now create: 1) A LinkedIn thought-leadership post (200 words) from this content, 2) A 10-tweet Twitter thread breaking down the key insights. Both should feel platform-native, not copy-pasted." STEP 5 — Stories + Newsletter Teaser: "Finally, create: 1) A 5-slide Instagram Story script driving traffic to the YouTube video, 2) A 3-line newsletter teaser email with subject line to promote the blog post."
💡 Pro Tip: This chain turns 1 hour of content thinking into a week's worth of posts across 5 platforms. Use this every Monday — brainstorm ONE idea, run the chain, batch-create everything, schedule, done.
C2

Audience Research → Content Strategy Chain

STEP 1 — Audience Deep Dive: "My content niche is [niche] and I target [audience] in India. Build a detailed audience avatar: demographics, psychographics, daily routine, content consumption habits (what YouTube channels, Instagram pages, podcasts), top 5 problems/pain points, what keeps them up at night, and what their dream transformation looks like." STEP 2 — Content Gap Analysis: "Based on this audience avatar, analyze what content they're searching for but NOT finding good answers to. List 10 underserved content topics that I can own. For each, note the platform where this topic would perform best." STEP 3 — 90-Day Content Strategy: "Using the audience insights and content gaps, create a 90-day content strategy. Month 1: Foundation (awareness + credibility building). Month 2: Growth (viral + collaborative content). Month 3: Monetization (product launch + authority establishment). Provide specific content themes and formats for each week."
💡 Pro Tip: Run this chain once every quarter. Your audience evolves — their problems, aspirations, and platform habits shift. A quarterly refresh keeps your content strategy aligned with what they actually need.

⚡ Quick-Fire Prompts

Q1

Trending Audio Adaptation

"This audio/trend is going viral on Instagram Reels: '[describe the trending audio or format]'. My niche is [niche]. Write 5 creative ways I can adapt this trend to fit my content while staying on-brand. For each adaptation, give me: the concept, shot description, and text overlay."
Q2

Bio Optimizer

"Optimize my Instagram bio. I'm a [your role/niche] targeting [audience]. My USP is [what makes you different]. My current bio is: '[current bio]'. Write 5 bio variations (each under 150 characters). Include: what you do, who it's for, a proof element, and a CTA. Use line breaks and 1-2 emojis."
Q3

Comment Reply Generator

"I got these comments on my post. Write witty, personality-driven replies that boost engagement (longer reply threads = algorithm boost). Comments: 1) '[comment 1]' 2) '[comment 2]' 3) '[comment 3]'. End each reply with a question to keep the thread going. My brand voice is [casual / witty / professional / quirky]."
Q4

Engagement Bait Post Ideas

"Generate 10 engagement-bait post ideas for my [niche] Instagram. Include: 3 'This or That' comparison posts, 2 'Rate my [X]' posts, 2 controversial opinion polls, 2 'Fill in the blank' caption ideas, and 1 'Caption this photo' concept. All should feel natural to my niche, not forced."
Q5

Content Idea from Trending News

"This news/event is trending in India right now: '[describe the trending topic]'. My niche is [niche]. Write 3 content pieces I can create that connect this trending topic to my niche. For each: content type (Reel/Carousel/Post), hook, brief outline, and why it would work. The connection should feel natural, not forced."
